---
title: "sampleFDataReport"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  sampleFData: NULL
  lengthWeightGraph: FALSE
  lengthFrequencyGraph: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(knitr)
require(tidyverse)
require(plotly)
```

```{r lwGraph, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
#print(params$lengthWeightGraph)
if(params$lengthWeightGraph){
  asis_output("## Parameter Passed")
  
  sampleFData <- params$sampleFData()
  
  plot <- sampleFData %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = Length_mm, y = Weight_g, color = CommonName)) +
          geom_point() + 
          theme_classic() +
          labs(title = "Length/Weight Data") #+
          #scale_color_manual(values = allColors)
  ggplotly(plot)
  
} else{
    asis_output("## Parameter not selected")

}
```
